sections.Objective:
Deliver `T009` so normal broad discovery reads can rely on healthy-session trust instead of paying the heavyweight path every time.

This task implements the broad-read routing contract without removing markdown-aware discovery.
sections.Relevant Domains:
- `Code Reading and Discovery`: this task changes the routing for broad natural-language discovery.
- `Resilience`: the broad path must still escalate when results are weak, empty, stale, or ambiguous.
- `Reuse at Every Scale`: it should consume the same query-scope and trust contracts created earlier rather than creating a separate broad pipeline.
sections.Candidate Design Slices: - `Slice PL-02 - Broad Discovery and Conditional Escalation` — use session-level trust for healthy broad reads while preserving markdown-aware behavior. Primary seams: `scripts/read_code.py:_resolve_pattern_anchor` and `scripts/read_code_health.py:_refresh_indexes_for_read`.
sections.Proposed Solution:
- Update the broad-query branch around `_resolve_pattern_anchor(...)` so healthy-session trust can satisfy ordinary broad discovery reads without forcing the slowest recovery path by default.
- Preserve the mixed code-plus-markdown candidate behavior for broad requests.
- Route only stale, empty, weak, or conflicting outcomes toward the heavier trust or recovery path.
- Change the following symbols in this task: `scripts/read_code.py:_resolve_pattern_anchor`, `scripts/read_code.py:read_code_context`, and the broad-read branch of the trust contract in `scripts/read_code_health.py`.
sections.Current Repo Behavior:
- Broad and scoped requests currently share the same preflight and anchor-resolution entrypoint.
- `_resolve_pattern_anchor(...)` always begins with the current semantic candidate path, and the surrounding preflight work does not distinguish broad requests that are already safe to satisfy from session trust.
- The broad path therefore inherits more heavyweight freshness work than necessary even when a healthy session is already available.
sections.Target Behavior:
- Broad discovery requests can use session-level trust in the healthy case.
- Broad requests still keep mixed code-plus-markdown discovery.
- The task fulfills `Slice PL-02` by moving heavyweight trust work to the exceptional cases instead of the default path.
sections.Reuse Candidates:
- Reuse the routed scope decision and trust evaluator from `T001` through `T003`.
- Reuse `_query_semantic_anchor_candidate(...)` and the mixed candidate path preserved by `T008`.
- Reuse the existing `vector_index_probe(...)` and refresh machinery only for escalation cases.
sections.Required Edits:
- Split the broad-read happy path from the broad-read escalation path.
- Preserve mixed retrieval behavior while narrowing when full freshness validation is required.
- Keep the public command behavior unchanged while internal routing becomes cheaper in the healthy case.
sections.Touched Symbols:
### Modify

- `scripts/read_code.py:_resolve_pattern_anchor` - route healthy broad reads through the normal mixed retrieval path and leave escalation for exceptional cases.
- `scripts/read_code.py:read_code_context` - pass the needed broad routing context.
- `scripts/read_code_health.py:_refresh_indexes_for_read` or adjacent trust helper - expose the healthy-session decision used by broad reads.

### Create

- None unless a small local helper is needed to classify broad retrieval outcomes.

### Preserve

- Preserve markdown-aware broad discovery.
- Preserve the existing compact output and shortlist behavior.
sections.Tests To Add Or Update:
- `tests/unit/test_read_code_shortlist.py` - add broad healthy-session routing assertions.
- `tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index.py` - extend mixed-scope coverage if needed to reflect the new broad path.
- Validation command: `uv run --no-sync python scripts/pytest_guard.py run -- tests/unit/test_read_code_shortlist.py tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index.py -k broad`.
sections.Acceptance Criteria:
- Healthy broad reads can proceed without the heavyweight path by default.
- Broad reads still preserve mixed code-plus-markdown behavior.
- Escalation remains available for the exceptional cases handled in `T010`.
sections.Done Criteria:
- The broad-read happy path uses healthy-session trust.
- The targeted broad-routing coverage passes.
- Broad discovery still surfaces markdown when it is relevant.
sections.Constraints And Invariants:
- Do not fold broad reads into the scoped fast path.
- Do not implement the detailed fallback trigger policy in this task; that belongs to `T010`.
- Preserve the single command surface and the mixed candidate behavior for broad reads.

- [ ] Preserve the escalation hook for exceptional outcomes.
- [ ] Verify the targeted broad-routing command passes.
